Jules (AE): Heads up — MeridianCare emailed procurement questions. They report a sudden 60% drop in API token consumption and say invoices look inconsistent. They mentioned evaluating a price-first vendor.
Maya (CSM): I pulled metrics — 7d tokens down ~60%, DAU down ~35%. Onboarding reported increased 502s last Wed around 08:40 UTC; could explain fallback behavior.
Ona (Customer Ops): Payment method changed 2026-03-05 and our audit shows an admin swap on 2026-03-01. I attached last 3 invoices to INC-10222.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Likely causes: model variant change, routing to higher-cost pool, or request-length shift. I'll run a quick replay and cost simulation. Commands I'll use in replay: redwood replay --account meridian --days 7 --out /tmp/meridian.json and redwood optimize compare --replay /tmp/meridian.json --variants base,quant.
Jules (AE): Customer wants a simple two-slide comparison (per-token delta + Dedicated 2-week trial cost). Can we show a projected savings >=15%?
Maya (CSM): I'll schedule a call with the new ML lead (Lena) and procurement for Thu 10am PT. Please prepare a one-pager with before/after P95 and cost sims.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): ETA: replay + preliminary Optimize report by EOD. Early signal: variant flip on 2026-03-02 and about 25% of requests grew in token length. A quantized route shows ~17% reduction in our sim.
Ona (Customer Ops): INC-10222 updated with CSV. triage-bot created ticket and assigned to customer-success (SLA 72h).
Jules (AE): Proposed next steps: 1) Ravi: replay + optimize report (EOD) 2) Ona: attach invoices & CSV (done) 3) Maya: schedule enablement call (Thu 10am PT) 4) Jules: draft Dedicated trial offer and slide (tomorrow noon).
Maya (CSM): I'll draft the success criteria (>=15% projected savings or resolution of 502 errors).
Jules (AE): Thanks team. Let's have the demo and offer ready for the call. (reactions: :thumbsup: Maya, :rocket: Ravi)
